correctness.rationale: For N>=q+1, q>=2, 0<p<=1, exchangeability yields exact birth/death rates U_k=(N-k)[(k)_q+p((N-1)_q-(k)_q-(N-k-1)_q)]/[N(N-1)_q], D_k=k(N-k)_q/[N(N-1)_q]. Inject exactly-one-plus mixed ordered panels qk(N-k-1)_(q-1) to show U_k>=pq D_k, including small remaining minus panels; equality at k=1. For pq>1, bounded supermartingale (pq)^(-X_t) and optional stopping imply all-N Moran lower bound. The birth-death harmonic product has fixed-k ratio D_k/U_k -> 1/(pq) as N grows. Geometric dominated convergence yields 1-(pq)^(-m) for pq>1; divergent denominator bounds yield 0 at/under pq=1, for each fixed m. Independently checked 2280 exact transition, injection, and fixation identities; finite checks do not prove the N limit.
